intro.text: An Elendel attorney and senior prosecutor, for whom Marasi Colms once worked as an intern; he led the prosecution at Miles Dagouter's trial.

items.text: Daius won a death sentence for Miles Dagouter. He never went to executions himself and advised Marasi to stay away as well, but she chose to attend.
Her internship under Daius convinced Marasi she would rather be a constable, as she disliked the rivalry and disorder of the prosecutor's office.
